steps.title: Principal orchestrator
steps.summary: Classifies every request, plans, delegates bounded work, inspects each diff itself, runs verification, and owns the outcome.
steps.selects: The provider, model, and thinking level used when a new principal session is started with orrery.
steps.shared_note: One continuous principal session runs every orchestrator step, so these nodes necessarily share a model.

steps.title: Mechanical worker
steps.summary: Handles narrow, repetitive, well-specified edits and boilerplate in a separate process.
steps.selects: The provider, model, and thinking level used by orrery-agent --role mechanic.

steps.title: Implementation worker
steps.summary: Handles contained features, real bug fixes, and coherent multi-file implementation tasks in a separate process.
steps.selects: The provider, model, and thinking level used by orrery-agent --role implementer.

steps.title: Plan reviewer
steps.summary: Challenges a complex or high-risk plan in a fresh, read-only process before code is written.
steps.selects: The provider, model, and thinking level used by orrery-agent --role plan-reviewer.

steps.title: Final reviewer
steps.summary: Reviews finished work or difficult diagnoses in a fresh, read-only process.
steps.selects: The provider, model, and thinking level used by orrery-agent --role reviewer.

plan_review_rounds.label: review rounds
plan_review_rounds.description: How many plan-review rounds complex work may use. Round one challenges the plan; later rounds only confirm that blocking objections were addressed. A repeated blocking objection, or one still open at the cap, escalates to the user rather than looping.
